name: Fieldnotes
tagline: A quieter place for your thoughts.

description.project: A lightweight journaling application for capturing daily notes, attaching photos, and revisiting entries through a chronological timeline.
description.technical: Mobile application built with React Native and Expo. Uses Supabase for authentication, PostgreSQL-backed data storage, and object storage for images. Local draft state allows users to continue writing before syncing an entry.

features.name: Daily entries
features.description: Users can create and edit dated journal entries with rich text and a title.
features.implementation: Created entry forms with local draft state and persisted entry records through Supabase. Entries are associated with their author and stored with normalized timestamps for chronological retrieval.

features.name: Photo attachments
features.description: Users can attach photos to journal entries and view them alongside the written note.
features.implementation: Integrated the device image picker, uploaded selected files to object storage, and saved attachment metadata against the corresponding entry. Added loading and failure states around upload operations.

features.name: Offline drafts
features.description: Allows users to continue composing an entry when a network connection is unavailable.
features.implementation: Persisted unfinished drafts locally and reconciled them with remote entry records when connectivity returned, while preserving the latest local edits until synchronization completed.

highlights: Implemented journal entry creation with locally persisted drafts.
Integrated device photo selection and remote attachment storage.
Added a chronological timeline for browsing previous entries.
